label: rem:parabolic-hecke-subalgebra-remark
title: Generator counts of the parabolic subalgebra
html: The cross-block generators are precisely the crossings created when the sub-units bond. Equivalently H_\lambda(q) is the q-deformation of the Young subgroup S_\lambda \subset S_N. Its intra-unit generator count is N - k. The bonding degrees of freedom number k-1. For benzene's \lambda = (2,2,2), there are 3 intra-unit generators and 2 bonding generators linking the three units into a ring, with the third join closing the ring.
